name: TestMACD
summary: This EA uses the standard MetaTrader 5 Expert Advisor framework with a MACD signal module to generate trade entries based on MACD histogram crossover logic. It employs fixed lot sizing with no trailing stop, relying on static stop-loss and take-profit levels for trade management. The EA is a boilerplate implementation built entirely from MQL5 standard library components.
summary_zh: 该EA使用MetaTrader 5标准专家框架，配合MACD信号模块，基于MACD柱状图交叉逻辑产生交易入场信号。采用固定手数下单，无移动止损，依赖静态止损止盈管理仓位。整体为基于MQL5标准库组件的模板化实现。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是MACD动量交易，通过快速EMA（12周期）与慢速EMA（24周期）的差值构建MACD线，再以信号线（9周期）作为触发条件，当MACD柱状图出现交叉信号时开仓。入场条件由CSignalMACD类内部逻辑决定，通常为MACD线与信号线的金叉做多、死叉做空。出场条件完全依赖固定止损（90点）和固定止盈（110点），没有使用任何移动止损策略（CTrailingNone），这意味着盈利仓位不会锁定浮盈。仓位管理采用CMoneyFixedLot固定手数模式，每次交易固定0.1手，不考虑账户余额变化动态调整。资金管理方面，虽然设置了10%的百分比参数，但固定手数模式下该参数仅影响风险计算，实际下单量始终为0.1手，缺乏根据波动率或账户风险动态调整仓位的能力。整体策略简单直接，但缺乏对市场环境变化的自适应能力。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is MACD momentum trading, constructing the MACD line from the difference between a fast EMA (period 12) and a slow EMA (period 24), then using a signal line (period 9) as the trigger. Entry conditions are determined by the CSignalMACD class internally, typically going long on a golden cross of the MACD line above the signal line and going short on a death cross. Exit conditions rely entirely on a fixed stop-loss of 90 points and a fixed take-profit of 110 points, with no trailing stop strategy employed (CTrailingNone), meaning profitable positions will not lock in floating gains. Position sizing uses the CMoneyFixedLot fixed lot model, always trading 0.1 lots regardless of account balance changes. Although a 10% percent parameter is set, in fixed lot mode it only affects risk calculation while the actual order size remains constant at 0.1 lots, lacking the ability to dynamically adjust position size based on volatility or account risk. The overall strategy is straightforward but lacks adaptability to changing market conditions.

pros: 基于MQL5标准库组件构建，代码结构规范、可维护性强
使用CExpert框架实现了信号、 trailing、资金管理的模块化分离，便于替换和扩展各模块
参数均可通过输入变量外部配置，方便优化和回测调整
每新Bar才执行交易逻辑（EveryTick=false），减少了频繁交易和过拟合风险
具备完整的参数验证流程（ValidationSettings），防止无效参数导致异常交易
pros_en: Built on MQL5 standard library components with clean, maintainable code structure
Uses CExpert framework for modular separation of signal, trailing, and money management, making it easy to swap or extend modules
All parameters are externally configurable via input variables, facilitating optimization and backtesting
Trades only on new bar formation (EveryTick=false), reducing overtrading and curve-fitting risks
Includes complete parameter validation flow (ValidationSettings) to prevent abnormal trading from invalid inputs
cons: 无移动止损策略，盈利仓位无法锁定浮盈，可能导致盈利回吐
固定手数仓位管理过于简单，未根据账户风险或市场波动率动态调整
止损90点与止盈110点的风险回报比仅为1:1.22，对于MACD动量策略偏保守
缺乏市场环境过滤机制，在震荡行情中MACD交叉信号容易产生频繁虚假信号
未设置点差过滤或交易时段过滤，高点差时段可能侵蚀利润
慢速EMA周期24非标准值（通常为26），可能与多数交易平台默认参数不一致
cons_en: No trailing stop strategy means profitable positions cannot lock in floating gains, potentially leading to profit givebacks
Fixed lot position sizing is overly simplistic, lacking dynamic adjustment based on account risk or market volatility
Stop-loss 90 points and take-profit 110 points yield a risk-reward ratio of only 1:1.22, which is conservative for a MACD momentum strategy
No market environment filter mechanism; MACD crossover signals frequently generate false signals in ranging markets
No spread filter or trading session filter, so high-spread periods can erode profits
Slow EMA period of 24 is non-standard (typically 26), which may be inconsistent with most platform default parameters
improvements: 增加移动止损模块（如CTrailingFixedPct或CTrailingMA）以保护浮盈，提升盈利能力
替换固定手数管理为动态仓位管理（如CMoneyFixedRisk），根据账户风险百分比和止损距离计算手数
增加趋势过滤条件（如更高时间周期均线方向或ADX指标），避免在震荡行情中频繁开仓
增加点差过滤和交易时段限制，避免在流动性差、点差高的时段交易
考虑增加MACD柱状图零轴过滤，仅在MACD与信号线同侧交叉时开仓，减少虚假信号
improvements_en: Add a trailing stop module (e.g., CTrailingFixedPct or CTrailingMA) to protect floating gains and improve profitability
Replace fixed lot money management with dynamic sizing (e.g., CMoneyFixedRisk) that calculates lot size based on account risk percentage and stop-loss distance
Add a trend filter condition (e.g., higher timeframe MA direction or ADX indicator) to avoid frequent entries in ranging markets
Add spread filter and trading session restrictions to avoid trading during low-liquidity, high-spread periods
Consider adding a MACD histogram zero-line filter, only entering on crossovers where MACD and signal line are on the same side of zero, reducing false signals

risk_points: 固定止损90点提供了一定的下行保护，但缺乏移动止损可能导致盈利仓位回吐
MACD在震荡行情中容易产生虚假信号，缺乏过滤机制可能导致连续小亏
固定手数不考虑账户规模变化，小账户可能承受过大风险，大账户则资金利用率不足
risk_points_en: Fixed 90-point stop-loss provides some downside protection, but lack of trailing stop may cause profitable positions to give back gains
MACD tends to generate false signals in ranging markets; absence of filtering mechanisms may lead to consecutive small losses
Fixed lot sizing ignores account size changes, potentially exposing small accounts to excessive risk while underutilizing capital in large accounts
